name: Frozen CUDA native host binding scoped API validation
registration: Before the first native binding timing, following the completed Python API and component studies
device_implementation: Identical cached R1 PTX for M1, R2 PTX otherwise; original per-shape frozen T/V choices, deterministic tile and exact BF16 checkpoint bits
preflight_policy: A launch that fails before the report or any timed case exists is not a measured process; preserve its error log and correct the unmet environmental precondition before retrying
eager_calls_per_round: max(32, number of physical weight copies), visiting every ring entry in each round
contexts: Stock RTX3070TiLaptop, Performance on AC, observed clocks/context source-bound, no custom clock or driver changes
precision: BF16 input/weights, FP32 accumulation, requested BF16 or FP32 output, TF32/reduced BF16 reduction disabled

arms.vendor: Allocation-including direct native torch.mm with prebound weight.T
arms.vendor_aa: Independently timed identical native Torch route
arms.native: Fixed allocating C++Torch op over exact original cached PTX; diagnostic even on failed kernel shapes. One metadata plan serves explicit physical tensor arguments; no per-copy plan preparation inside calls.
arms.python_registered: Original allocating Python registered custom op called with explicit ring tensor arguments, same packed buffers/configuration
arms.selected: Native op only if this shape passed every original kernel gate; otherwise prebound native Torch without packing in the selected call

configuration_for_controls: Fixed coded_t64_v8, never selected as a custom winner
configuration_for_real_cases: Frozen original profile choice for each shape, no search or latency-driven changes
scopes: Report synchronized allocation-including eager and captured allocation-including graph separately. No reuse-output baseline against allocating native op.
numerics: Exact original weight-bit preservation, native-versus-old-wrapper output bit parity, unchanged FP64 oracle on every arm and physical ring output, before/after timing checks
gates: Each case requires stable observed context, numeric checks, abs(vendor A/A)<=1%; custom gain requires paired95% lower saved-latency bound>10%; fallback overhead requires paired95% lower bound>=-1%. Every registered synthetic fallback control must pass for its scope. Preserve all failures; no rerun until pass.
claims: Scoped API comparison to direct Torch only, not best-of-all-vendors or full-model throughput. Original kernel-only full-vendor evidence remains separate. Three fresh processes required for an accepted scoped result.
reporting: All 12 cases per process, raw paired rounds, exact source/PTX/native binary/input/profile/evidence hashes, runtime/device/unlock inventory, context snapshots and plan metadata; no absent unlocked or energy cells fabricated
